{
  "name": "game-hedge-mark",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Hedge Mark",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Claude's replies in a window headed CLAUDE; sentences that guess (아마, 추정, probably, might …) marked [?], with a footer counting them",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-hedge-mark",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "replies",
    "uncertainty",
    "transcript"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off leaves replies to the engine; casual draws the window and marks guesses; hardcore marks guesses without the window",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)",
      "default": "nes",
      "options": [
        "nes",
        "gameboy",
        "amber",
        "theme"
      ]
    }
  }
}
